verdict.rationale: Evidence shows Mercury Books supports GL codes/chart-of-accounts organization (Command can 'organize your chart of accounts', bulk-assign GL codes) and Class/tag dimensions can be attached to transactions via enriched QuickBooks/NetSuite integrations, but there is no explicit documentation of creating custom account types or sub-accounts within Books itself. Missing for 10: explicit UI/API support for defining account types and sub-accounts natively in Mercury Books, independent hands-on verification of COA customization depth.
